source.detail: /sse aliases no longer serve deprecated HTTP+SSE transport

spec_evidence.old_version: MCP 2025 Streamable HTTP / HTTP+SSE era endpoints
spec_evidence.checked: Full changelog prose in DB raw_excerpt: Cloudflare MCP servers now run stateless per-request under the MCP 2026-07-28 spec. /mcp accepts stateless requests from 2025 Streamable HTTP clients and most clients reconnect unchanged. Historical /sse URLs remain as aliases for the same Streamable HTTP handler but no longer serve the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport - clients that force SSE transport break.

fix.migration_guide: Only MCP client configurations that force the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport against Cloudflare product MCP servers break. The mechanical fix is in client code/config: switch the transport type from SSE to Streamable HTTP (or automatic transport detection), and prefer the /mcp endpoint for new connections (/sse URLs still resolve but only as Streamable HTTP aliases). Clients already using Streamable HTTP or auto-detection need no change. Sessions are now stateless per request, so remove any client-side assumptions about a persistent MCP protocol session.
